Indian housing sales decline 6% in Q1 amid economic concerns

Housing sales in India's top seven cities decreased by 6% in the first quarter of 2026, according to a report by Anarock. Economic uncertainties and the conflict in the Middle East were cited as factors affecting buyer sentiment. Despite the dip, developers increased new home launches, indicating a positive long-term outlook. While some cities saw declines, others experienced growth.
